controlled_arena.source_difference_review: ort_sovits.py gained an opt-in acoustic_arena_shrink argument, validation and member state, defaulting to false. The probe loads with that default and calls session.run directly with its own RunOptions, bypassing the new decode branch. CUDA provider/session settings and probe code are unchanged. Hash differences remain recorded, not normalized away.

initial_arena_confounded.limitation: Initial polyphase used deterministic_compute=false versus true for zero-insert; retained, not used as the matched method comparison.
